newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF survey shows gradual economic recovery.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF survey shows gradual economic recovery.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Wednesday its latest quarterly corporate survey, covering the three months to September, showed Japan's economy recovering moderately.
The quarterly survey asking 12,200 companies how they viewed their business conditions in the July-September period showed they thought business was improving.
The survey, conducted in August, showed an increasing number of companies expected the economy to improve in the next two quarters.

They expected profits in the current business year to next March 31 to rise 18.2 percent over the previous year. It also showed that big corporations, especially manufacturers, still had excess workers.

Many companies cited high competition between domestic rivals, stagnant sales and falling prices as factors hurting their business, but fewer of them suffered from currency fluctuations due to the yen's recent retreat.
